tool.name: FAIR-bioHeaders strip
tool.description: remove the metadata header from FASTA, GFA or GFF3
tool.command: @SET_TYPE@ ## Check that the dataset has a header before stripping it. If no header is found, ## the dataset probably has the wrong datatype, so stop with a clear error. ## Any other problem with the header is left for the strip step below to handle. bioheaders convert --from '$type' --to yaml '$input' header.yaml 2> header-check.txt || true ; if grep -qE '^FHR: No [;#]~ FHR metadata header found$' header-check.txt; then echo "No FAIR-bioHeaders header found for datatype $input.ext (read as $type): check the dataset's datatype." >&2 ; exit 1 ; fi && #if $metadata_format != 'none' bioheaders convert --from '$type' --to '$metadata_format' '$input' '$metadata' && #end if #if $compressed #set $out = 'stripped.' + $type + '.gz' #else #set $out = 'stripped.' + $type #end if bioheaders strip --type '$type' '$input' '$out' && mv '$out' '$output'

param.name: input
param.label: Data file with a header
param.help: FASTA, GFA or GFF3, plain or gzip-compressed.

param.name: metadata_format
param.label: Also save the metadata as
param.help: The header's metadata, as a separate dataset.

has_text.text: No FAIR-bioHeaders header found for datatype fasta

tool.help:
.. class:: infomark
**What it does**
Removes the FAIR-bioHeaders header from a FASTA, GFA or GFF3 file with the fair-bioheaders_ toolkit (``bioheaders strip``). Every other byte of the file is kept, so stripping and recombining with the same metadata gives the same content (a compressed file comes back as BGZF, which may differ byte for byte from the original gzip). Optionally, the header's metadata are saved as a separate YAML, JSON or JSON-LD dataset.
Use it before a tool that rejects or misreads headed files, or to edit the metadata and add them back with **FAIR-bioHeaders combine**.
@HEADER_HELP@
-----
**Input**
A FASTA, GFA or GFF3 file with a header, plain or gzip-compressed. If no header is found the job fails: check that the dataset's datatype is right (a FASTA header starts with ``;~``, a GFA or GFF3 header with ``#~``).
**Output**
- The file without the header, in the same datatype. - Optionally, the metadata in YAML, JSON or JSON-LD. JSON-LD is available for FHR (genome) metadata only so far, not yet for FHP or FHGFF3.
@GALAXY_HELP@
@LINKS@
